verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a search engine that stores documents and embeddings. However, the evidence pack documents no export, dump, snapshot, or document-retrieval-for-migration capability, and nothing about open export formats. Self-hosting as a single binary concerns deployment portability, not data export, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
